title: CallAnswers
description: Answers the voice agent recorded during one call through its record_answer tool, as stored (in CallEndedBody.answers and voice.call_answers). Code builds this object from the tool calls; the model emits no events (I4). Spoken account digits never appear here: account_last4 holds only a keyed hash and a digit count. The shape that carries the digits to decide() in memory is $defs/CallAnswersInTransit, used only in the core-voice API (openapi/internal.yaml).

call_id.description: The call these answers came from (voice.calls.id).

answers.description: In the order recorded. A slot may appear more than once; decide() treats conflicting values as inconsistent.

Slot.description: Fixed list. The agent cannot invent slots.

AnswerBase.description: Fields and per-slot value types shared by both shapes. account_last4 is typed separately in StoredAnswer and TransitAnswer.

turn_id.description: Transcript turn the answer came from. Code checks the value appears in that turn.

tool_call_id.description: The record_answer tool call ID, or the keypad event ID when capture_method is keypad.

capture_method.description: speech: the agent heard it and recorded it with record_answer. keypad: the callee pressed keys (DTMF) and code captured them, not the model.

then.description: A number the callee asked us to call instead. Recorded as heard and never dialed.

value.description: speaker_changed: someone else came on the line or gave a different name; the agent re-asks name and role (spec 0012, D4; read by decide() as NR in spec 0006).

StoredAnswer.description: An answer as stored. account_last4 is a keyed hash, never digits.

digits_hmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the spoken digits with the server-side key, as lowercase hex.

digit_count.description: How many digits were given. Fewer than 4 counts as not_provided.

key_version.description: Which HMAC key was used, so keys can rotate.

TransitAnswer.description: An answer on its way from the voice service to the core. account_last4 carries the digits, held only in memory for decide().

CallAnswersInTransit.description: Same as the root object, but account_last4 holds the digits. Only in the call_ended request to the core; never stored or logged by either service. The core runs decide(), then stores the root shape.
